dct_description_sm: Cartographic Details: Scale approximately 1:2,112,000 (E 062°05'--E 075°10'/N 037°40'--N 023°25'). Relief shown by hachures. Map incorporates Afghanistan, Baluchistan, Bukhara, Kutch, Punjab, Rajasthan, and Sind.
